sn47.45:1.1: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammāvadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.45:1.2: kevalo cāyaṃ bhikkhave, kusalarāsi yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
sn47.45:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.45:2.6: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.45:2.7: kevalo hayaṃ bhikkhave, kusalarāsi. yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti.
